Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1.

Heard Shri Manvendra Singh, learned counsel for the petitioner, Shri Kuldeep Mishra, holding
brief of Shri Aftab Khan, learned counsel for the informant and Shri Ratan Singh, learned A.G.A.
appearing for the State -respondents.

2. This writ petition has been filed praying to quash the impugned First Information Report dated
04.01.2024 registered as Case Crime No. 07 of 2024, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 406, 504,
352 Ipc, P.S. Budhana District Muzaffarnagar.

3.
Vide order dated 01.08.2024 the matter was referred to the Mediation Centre.

4. Perused the settlement agreement dated 08.08.2024 which indicates that matter has been peacefully settled between the parties and they have settled their differences on the terms mentioned in paragraph 8 of the settlement agreement dated 08.08.2024.

The paragraph 8 is quoted as under:-
"8. The following settlement has been arrived at between the Parties hereto:-
a) That the parties have already settled their dispute and filed a compromise dated 03.07.2024 before the Hon'ble Court in Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. 12053 of 2024.

Further they reiterate and reaffirm the terms and conditions mentioned in compromise dated 03.07.2024, as such there remains no dispute between the parties.
b) That in view of the above, if the Hon'ble Court pleases to allow the Criminal Misc.

entities.text:

entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: c) That the parties will not file any fresh case against each other in respect of this dispute.
They have no claim against each other in future also.
d) That it has been agreed between the parties that they shall not violate the terms and conditions of this settlement otherwise the aggrieved party will be free to take legal recourse."
5. It is submitted that as between the parties compromise had already taken place therefore, the impugned First Information Report is liable to be quashed.

6. Thus, in view of the well settled principles of law as laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court reported in 2003(4) SCC 675 (B.S. Joshi Vs. State of Haryana), J.T. 2008(9) SC 192 (Nikhil Merchant Vs.
Central Bureau of investigation and another), (2012) 10 SCC 303 (Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab),
(2014) 9 SCC 653 (Yogendra Yadav and others Vs. State of Jharkhand) and also (2014) 6 SCC 466 (Narendra Singh Vs. State of Punjab), and in view of the settlement agreement dated 08.08.2024 the First Information Report dated 04.01.2024 registered as Case Crime No. 07 of 2024, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 406, 504, 352 IPC, P.S. Budhana District Muzaffarnagar is hereby quashed.
7.
